input: Yo, I am literally stuck in the parking lot right now and this is super urgent. I just bought a new bike and some camping gear, but I realized I messed up my shipping address. I need to change it to my friend's house because I can't pick it up today. I know you guys said address changes are free within 24 hours of purchase, so please just fix it for me right now. I don't have time to wait for a callback or anything. Also, my total was over $150.00, so I should be getting free standard shipping, right? I don't want to pay extra fees on top of this mess. I need this sorted out immediately because I'm blocked from doing what I came here for. If you don't update the address and confirm the free shipping status in the next few minutes, I'm seriously going to be upset. Please just look at my order and make it happen. I'm waiting by the phone. Thanks, hopefully this is quick.
prompt:
You are the Northwind Outdoor support assistant. Northwind Outdoor sells bikes and camping gear.

You receive (a) the customer's ticket and (b) the handbook excerpts retrieved for this ticket. Answer only from those excerpts.

Required-fact completeness. Before you write the reply, list every fact the ticket needs answered (fee amounts, deadlines, eligibility conditions, point rates, retention periods, caps, and similar concrete values). Then verify each one is present in the excerpts. Include every fact you find, with the exact value as written (e.g. "$15.00 Express upgrade fee", "within 48 hours", "5 points per $1.00"). If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.

***

**Reply:**

I can confirm the policy details regarding your address change and shipping costs based on the handbook excerpts.

**Address Change**
You may change your shipping address within 24 hours of placing your order at no additional cost [Shipping]. This window is strict; after 24 hours, a $10.00 administrative fee applies [Shipping]. Additionally, if the tracking number has already been generated and the package has left the warehouse, address changes are no longer possible [Shipping]. If the 24-hour window has passed but the order has not yet shipped, you must cancel the order and place a new one [Order Changes].

**Shipping Costs**
*   **Free Shipping Threshold:** Northwind Outdoor offers free standard shipping on all orders totaling $150.00 or more before tax and discounts [Shipping]. This applies to domestic addresses within the United States [Shipping].
*   **Freight Shipping for Bikes:** Bikes are shipped via freight carriers. The base freight cost is $85.00 for a single large item [Shipping]. Additional large items incur a surcharge of $40.00 each [Shipping].
*   **Freight Delivery:** Freight delivery takes 5 to 8 business days [Shipping]. You must be present to sign for the delivery [Shipping]. If you are not available, the carrier will attempt delivery three times over 3 consecutive business days before returning the item to the warehouse, which may result in a restocking fee of 15% of the item’s value [Shipping].

**Important Note on "Free Shipping" vs. Freight**
The free shipping benefit applies to **standard shipping** [Shipping]. However, bikes are explicitly stated to ship via **freight carriers** [Shipping]. The excerpts do not state that the $150.00 free standard shipping threshold waives the $85.00 base freight cost for bikes. Therefore, while your order may qualify for free standard shipping on eligible items, the bike itself will likely incur the $85.00 freight fee [Shipping].

**Action Required**
I cannot directly access or modify your live order status, tracking number, or current timestamp to determine if you are within the 24-hour window or if the package has already left the warehouse. Because the ability to change the address depends entirely on these real-time order statuses [Shipping], I must escalate this ticket to a human agent who can verify your order's current status and apply the address change or cancellation if necessary.
